evidence_items.publisher: Demirci, Hannane and Zhu; Boston University Platform Strategy Research Symposium
evidence_items.explanation: The study finds relative declines in writing and image-related freelance postings, consistent with substitution for discrete creative assignments. Its data end in July 2023, and it does not identify early-career workers or compare complete occupational replacement.

The survey distinguishes task substitution from employment reductions, consistent with one part of Zitron's contrast. It covers AI broadly through February 2024, not generative AI or early-career creative work specifically.

unresolved_gaps: No verified target-period study jointly measures whole-role replacement and discrete creative-task substitution.
The cited freelance study does not identify early-career workers or portfolio-building opportunities.
Declining postings alone do not establish how successfully AI performed the displaced assignments.
